recipe.variant: LacklusterOpsec fork, v1.1 weights, 4x, mode tiny (TCDecoder), bf16, tiled VAE + tiled DiT, unload_dit, frame_chunk_size 50: the 16 GB row of the pack's VRAM table (12 GB row: fp16 + LightVAE_W2.1; 8 GB row: tiny-long + LightTAE_HY1.5 + chunks of 16-32 + fp16)
recipe.from_template: No Comfy-Org local template. Same graph as upscale-video-4x with the README's 16 GB row applied (tiny, Wan2.1, tiling enabled, chunk 50-100, bf16) and the simple node's 'Recommended for 16GB VRAM' unload_dit=True.
recipe.min_comfyui_note: NOT FOUND (neither pack states a ComfyUI minimum); the native spine nodes exist in v0.35.0
recipe.confidence_note: pack README VRAM table + nodes.py defaults (official for the pack); node ids/params corroborated by the upstream lihaoyun6 README

scale.note: 2-4; official: 4x is the trained setting ('strongly recommend'), 2x only as a VRAM concession

mode.note: tiny (this row) | tiny-long for the 8 GB row / very long clips | full needs the 24 GB row

vae_model.note: Wan2.1 (16 GB row) | LightVAE_W2.1 (12 GB row, '50% less VRAM') | LightTAE_HY1.5 (8 GB row)

precision.note: bf16 (16 GB row) | fp16 (12 GB and 8 GB rows) | fp8_e4m3fn (Ada/Hopper, halves VRAM)

attention_mode.note: sparse_sage_attention (sm_75-sm_120) | block_sparse_attention (sm_80-sm_100, official backend) | flash_attention_2 | sdpa | sage_attention_2; keep a SPARSE backend for quality parity

force_offload.note: offload all weights to CPU after the run

tiled_vae.note: lower memory at the cost of speed

tiled_dit.note: 'Significantly reduces VRAM usage at the cost of speed'

unload_dit.note: unload the DiT before decoding to cut the VRAM peak (slower); the simple node defaults it True 'Recommended for 16GB VRAM'

color_fix.note: wavelet colour transfer to the source; keep True

resize_factor.note: 0.1-1.0 pre-shrink of the input before upscaling

video.note: the clip to upscale; frames go to the FlashVSR node, fps and audio pass from GetVideoComponents to CreateVideo. FlashVSR is a streaming model: feed a clip (>= 21 frames), not a still.

recipe.files_note: the four files of the JunhaoZhuang/FlashVSR-v1.1 HF repo, downloaded as-is into ComfyUI/models/FlashVSR/ (the node's `model` option names the version folder); the exact subfolder layout the pack expects: NOT FOUND, follow the pack README. The fixed prompt embedding (posi_prompt.pth) ships inside the node repo. The alternative VAEs (lightx2v/Autoencoders: lightvaew2_1.pth, lighttaehy1_5.pth, taew2_2.safetensors, Wan2.2_VAE.pth) are auto-downloaded by the pack when selected.
recipe.packs_note: mutually exclusive with lihaoyun6/ComfyUI-FlashVSR_Ultra_Fast (same node class ids)
recipe.defaults_note: 16 GB row: tiny, Wan2.1, bf16, tiling on, unload_dit on, chunks of 50 frames. Progressive fallback the pack describes: tiled VAE -> tiled DiT -> chunking. For 12 GB: fp16 + LightVAE_W2.1; for 8 GB: tiny-long + LightTAE_HY1.5 + chunks 16-32.

vram_evidence.at: mode tiny, VAE Wan2.1/LightVAE_W2.1, tiling optional, frame_chunk_size 50-100, bf16
vram_evidence.usage: NOT FOUND (settings per VRAM class, no measured number)

verify: Native spine (LoadVideo -> GetVideoComponents -> CreateVideo -> SaveVideo) checked against the v0.35.0 registry on 2026-10-01. The FlashVSR classes are a custom pack: the offline validator reports them as 'not in v0.35.0' and, as a consequence, CreateVideo.images as 'has no output 0' (it cannot type the pack node's output). Expected for a pack recipe; resolves once the pack is installed and the live /object_info is read (Phase 2).

Input names, options and defaults are transcribed from the dossier's reading of the pack's nodes.py / README (2026-10-01), not from a registry: confirm the exact required key set against the live /object_info after install (an API prompt must carry every required widget).
